0.why: CLK-01.cpp:63 resetTrigger.process(inputs[RESET_INPUT].getVoltage()) at Rack's default 0V and 1V thresholds, with no getChannels anywhere

comment: Read from the source at tag 2.1.2 (commit d57e97e), which is the installed build. The module adds nothing to Rack's right-click menu, so there are no menu lines. The rate range 0.1Hz to 20Hz is CLK_MIN_HZ and CLK_MAX_HZ at lines 5-6, the pulse width CLK_PULSE_SEC at line 11 and the divisors at line 14. The division counter wraps rather than being reset when the knob is turned, so a change of division lands on the next tick.
